system.description: This multicolored, multifaceted gem is an example of an unusually specialized hearthstone. The possessor of this hearthstone can opt to receive an incoming Infallible Messenger mentally, without the visible and audible cherub effect, and can store and redisplay at will up to five Infallible Messenger missives. If the gem's owner casts Infallible Messenger herself, she can give the spell multiple targets at a cost of 5 motes per additional recipient, up to a maximum of five recipients. Finally, the bearer can personalize the cherubic display of the spell to a limited degree. However, the voice from the magical messenger remains the same as the character's own.
